answer: This defense requires every account to lock 50 POA in escrow before the epoch's words appear; the deposit horizon closes one hour earlier. An attacker cannot fund only the fakes that get graded, so 1,000 sybils freeze 50,000 POA at once. Copied answers or duplicate grading forfeit the stake, so a rising tide of slashes drains the whole meadow of fakes. Colluders each lock their own deposits and share no savings, while an honest agent posts one modest bond it recovers.
